name: I Am
overview: The declaration 'I Am' reveals God's eternal and unchanging nature, as first expressed to Moses when God identified Himself as 'I AM THAT I AM' (Exodus 3:14). This divine name assures believers of God's constant presence and strength, as seen in Isaiah's encouragement that God is with His people and will uphold them (Isaiah 41:10). Jesus Christ affirms His deity and life-giving power through the 'I Am' statements, proclaiming Himself as the bread of life, the light of the world, and the eternal one who existed before Abraham (John 6:35; 8:12; 8:58). These truths call for faith in Christ as the source of spiritual life and salvation, warning that rejecting His identity results in remaining in sin (John 8:24).
